types.name: Facing direction after turns
types.description: A person faces some direction and turns left, right, or by angles (90° clockwise, 135° anticlockwise); asks which way they face at the end (or at the start).

types.name: Distance and direction from start
types.description: A person walks several distances, turning left or right or towards named directions; asks how far and in which direction they are from the starting point, or the shortest distance.

types.name: Shadow questions
types.description: Uses the sun at sunrise, morning or evening and the side on which a shadow falls to find which direction a person is facing.

types.name: Relative position of points
types.description: Several points, houses or people are placed relative to each other (P is 20 m north of Q), sometimes with symbols for directions; asks the position of one point with respect to another.
